Company description:
Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. 
Job description:   
 At Enterprise Cybersecurity, we are strengthening our Compliance & Audit function.
 To achieve this, we are establishing a common cybersecurity control framework that brings together regulatory, contractual, industry-standard and internal requirements into one clear, testable and measurable baseline.
 We are now looking for two experienced cybersecurity professionals to help define, build and operate this capability.
  
 Your responsibilities will include:
  Establishing and maintaining a common cybersecurity control framework covering requirements from regulations, industry standards, customer commitments and internal policies, including frameworks such as NIS2, ISO/IEC 27001 and the Cyber Resilience Act.
 Managing the requirement lifecycle by analyzing new and updated requirements, normalizing them and determining how they should be reflected in the control framework.
 Designing and maintaining clear, testable controls, including control objectives, ownership, applicability criteria and testing requirements.
 Collaborating closely with the Standards & Procedures Office to ensure a clear separation between what must be achieved (controls) and how it is implemented (standards and procedures).
 Designing assurance methodologies for evaluating control effectiveness, including testing approaches, effectiveness ratings and evidence models.
 Creating a reporting structure that enables visibility into compliance status, control effectiveness, gaps and exposure across the organization.
 Driving the use of tooling and automation to support control management, requirement mapping, testing and evidence collection.
 Supporting audits, assessments and regulatory reviews by providing a consistent and reliable control framework.
  Who are you? 
 
 We believe you have
  At least 5 years of experience in cybersecurity governance, compliance, IT audit, risk management or assurance.
 Strong experience working with cybersecurity regulations and frameworks such as NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act, ISO/IEC 27001/27002, NIST CSF or similar.
 Experience harmonizing requirements from multiple sources into a single control framework or baseline.
 Experience defining, maintaining or assessing cybersecurity controls.
 Experience working with Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) platforms and supporting processes.
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
 Fluent English, spoken and written.
 A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  
 
 Valuable additional experience
  Certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC or ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor/Lead Implementer.
 Experience working in large, complex and globally distributed organizations.
 Experience supporting regulatory audits or compliance initiatives.

Vitec BidTheatre builds software and solutions for data-driven online marketing. Our platform enables media agencies, brands and other marketing professionals to manage and deliver programmatic advertising campaigns.
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our small engineering team in Stockholm. The position offers a high degree of independence, technical ownership and the opportunity to influence the continued development of our platform.
About the role
As a member of our engineering team, you will work across our technology stack, developing and maintaining the applications and services that power our advertising platform.
A key part of your role will be taking the lead in the continued development of BidTheatre Studio, our web application used by clients and internal teams to manage digital advertising campaigns. You will have significant influence over frontend architecture, technical decisions and development practices.
Beyond the frontend, you will also be actively involved in developing and maintaining our backend systems, including APIs, business logic and data processing. We are looking for someone with solid experience in both frontend and backend development who is comfortable taking responsibility across the entire application stack.
Our frontend uses React, TypeScript and Redux. Our backend is primarily Java-based, with technologies such as SQL, Redis, Aerospike, Kafka and Spark supporting our data-intensive platform.
We embrace modern development practices, including AI-assisted coding, and encourage experimentation with tools that improve productivity and code quality.
We believe you are an experienced and versatile developer who enjoys understanding how systems work as a whole. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex tasks, making technical decisions and working independently, while collaborating closely with your colleagues.
Requirements
5+ years of professional software development experience

Strong experience with React, TypeScript and modern frontend development

Solid professional experience in backend development using Java or comparable technologies such as C#/.NET or Kotlin

Ability and willingness to work with Java-based backend systems

Good understanding of SQL and relational databases

Experience developing and maintaining larger web applications

Good understanding of software architecture, performance and maintainability

Ability to independently drive technical decisions and development

Experience with Git, testing and modern development practices

Good written and spoken English skills

Nice to have
Experience with Redux Toolkit, RTK Query or Redux Saga

Experience with distributed or high-volume systems

Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Codex, Claude Code or similar

Interest in UX/UI design

Experience with ad tech or programmatic advertising

Degree in Computer Science

Fluency in Swedish

What we offer
You will be part of a small, experienced engineering team where your contributions make a real difference. You will have the freedom to take ownership of your work, influence technical decisions and contribute across different parts of a complex platform.
Our systems handle large volumes of data and real-time transactions, offering a broad range of technical challenges in a profitable and established software business.
Application: The application deadline is 13th of December 2026. We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, as applications are reviewed and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.
If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Andreas Green at Andreas.Green@vitecsoftware.com.
Location: The position is based at our office in Stockholm.

BidTheatre DSP is a programmatic marketing platform built for media agencies, advertisers and integrators. With BidTheatre, marketers get unified and efficient access to the fragmented media landscape with banner, video, audio, native, CTV, and digital out of home (DOOH) advertising. jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician for an International MedTech Company!
jobs.description:
Are you a service-oriented problem solver? On behalf of our client, we are currently looking for an IT Support Technician in Stockholm for a 1-year temporary position. Become a key player at a global MedTech company whose tools make a difference in healthcare. Apply today!
About the role
Our client is an established and innovative Swedish medical technology company that develops digital decision-support tools to facilitate and ensure quality in assessments and treatment follow-ups within neuropsychiatry. With headquarters in Stockholm and operations in the UK and the USA, among other countries, the company is characterized by an open, multicultural, and family-like atmosphere where technology and societal benefit go hand in hand.
As one of the colleagues on the team is going on study leave, we are now looking for a replacement for a one-year temporary position to secure daily IT delivery, starting with a thorough handover in December.
In the role of IT Support Technician, you will serve as the hub for daily technical support at the Stockholm office, while also supporting colleagues at the London office remotely. You will work broadly with 1st line support (with the opportunity to take on 2nd line tickets as you grow into the role) in a mixed Windows and macOS environment. At the Stockholm office, there is an open "digital workplace" area where employees can drop by for quick assistance, making you a visible and appreciated point of contact for the entire organization. In addition to your colleagues at the office, you will collaborate closely with your own international IT team—consisting of colleagues in Stockholm, the UK, and the USA—holding weekly check-ins to distribute workload and drive tickets forward.
You are offered:
An international and welcoming workplace where you contribute to products that make a real difference for both healthcare providers and patients.
The opportunity to work broadly in a modern Microsoft environment with great prospects for technical development toward 2nd line support and automation.
A solid introduction at our client's company with a structured and thorough handover from your current colleague.

Work tasks
Daily Support & Ticket Management: Provide 1st line IT support (and 2nd line, depending on experience) on-site in Stockholm and remotely for the UK, as well as manage incoming tickets in Jira Service Management.  
User & Device Management: Take responsibility for onboarding and offboarding, hardware and license management (asset management), and administration in Microsoft 365, Entra ID (SSO), and Intune.  
Troubleshooting & IT Security: Troubleshoot in Windows and macOS, trace phishing emails in Microsoft Defender, escalate incidents, and work with existing scripts in PowerShell and Microsoft Graph.

We are looking for
Has 3–5 years of experience working in IT support or a similar IT service role.
Has a strong technical understanding and practical experience working in a Microsoft environment, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and Defender.
Has strong troubleshooting skills in both Windows and macOS.
Has a strong security mindset and understands the importance of regulatory compliance and data security.
Has very good proficiency in English, both spoken and written, as it is the corporate language and you will communicate daily with colleagues in the UK and the USA. Knowledge of Swedish is a plus.

It is considered meritorious if you have:
Experience with ticket management in Jira Service Management.
Basic knowledge of PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, or AI tools to streamline workflows.
Previous experience from a regulated industry, such as MedTech or Life Science.

To succeed in this role, you have the following personal qualities:
We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and are looking for someone who is distinctly service-oriented, helpful, and unpretentious. Since you will meet colleagues both via the ticketing system and face-to-face at the office, you are communicative, patient, and able to explain technical solutions in a pedagogical way to people without a technical background. Furthermore, you are structured, thorough, and enjoy collaborating in an international team where everyone pitches in to solve tasks.
Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Are you passionate about the future of physical retail and turning strategy into tangible customer experiences? Do you understand what makes a store format commercially relevant, operationally strong and scalable across markets?

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Lead and coordinate the creation of new store formats and specific developments to increase relevance and performance in our store portfolio.

Experience driving complex, cross-functional projects or initiatives from direction through implementation.

Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to align multiple functions and perspectives. 
The ability to translate broad strategic direction into concrete briefs, principles and actions.

Strong communication and collaboration skills. 
Experience from fashion retail or another large, complex retail organization is highly relevant. Experience from H&M or a similar global retail environment is an advantage given the cross-functional nature and complexity of the role. 

And people who are… 
Curious, pragmatic and outcome-oriented. 
Comfortable working across organizational boundaries and challenging, influencing and bringing people with you. 
Able to connect the right perspectives, challenge assumptions and move initiatives forward, without needing to own every area yourself.

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

25% staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).

jobs.occupation: Safety Engineer for the Engine Management System
jobs.description:
Role Summary
This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden 
Would you like to combine hands-on safety engineering with complex technical challenges—and see your work contribute to vehicles across the TRATON Group? 
As a Safety Engineer for our Engine Management System, you will conduct safety analyses and define safety measures to address risks arising from malfunctions in electrical/electronic systems and mechanical powertrain components. You will work with engine and aftertreatment control systems in a domain where safety, vehicle performance and environmental impact are closely connected. You will be close to product decisions through participation in approval forums and system-level decision meetings.
Job Responsibilities 
Your tasks will include:
Creation of structured, systematic techniques such as Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA).
Development of technical safety concepts for the engine and after treatment systems.
Contribute to the further development of safety processes and culture at the Powertrain Controls department.

 
Perform safety analysis like FTA (Fault Tree Analysis) and DFA (Dependent Failure Analysis)
Who You Are 
We are looking for a curious and analytical professional with a strong passion for functional safety and a collaborative mindset. You thrive in cross-functional environments, take ownership of your work, and enjoy solving complex problems in a structured and methodical manner. You can drive topics independently and confidently navigate technical discussions with a variety of stakeholders. 
Experience working with functional safety and leading technical development activities is highly valued. Familiarity with industry standards, particularly ISO 26262 (with emphasis on Parts 4, 5, and 6), as well as experience developing products in regulated environments, would be a strong advantage. Knowledge of software and hardware safety monitoring concepts is also desirable. 
Additional qualifications include an interest in programming, experience with Python, and an understanding of engines and vehicle systems. You hold a degree in engineering or equivalent and possess strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in Swedish, or a willingness to learn the language, is considered an advantage. A Category C/D driving license is also beneficial. 
We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.
This Is Us 
You will join a team of 14 engineers working across System Ownership, Functional Safety, Safety Engineering, Requirements Engineering and Cybersecurity. Together, we support the Engine and Aftertreatment Control Systems—among Scania's most advanced real-time control systems—and help ensure compliance with functional safety standards and cybersecurity regulations in markets including the EU, China, and the United States. 
Our responsibilities span several disciplines, but we work towards a shared goal. We take ownership of our respective areas while helping each other solve problems and succeed with our deliveries. There is always someone to discuss a challenging technical question with, explore a different perspective or ask for support. 
We value an open environment where you can ask questions, share ideas and learn from others. Our different cultural and educational backgrounds bring a range of perspectives, and knowledge sharing and personal development are important parts of how we work. Here, you will have room to deepen your expertise while contributing to the team's collective knowledge and results. 
Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry.
TRATON Offers 
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. 
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally. 
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.
Application 
We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. 
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-03. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. 
If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:
Elisabet Larsson Landström, Unit Head, elisabet.larsson.landstrom@scania.com 
We look forward to your application!
This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Group R&D

We are now looking for a QA Supplier Quality Specialist to join our Supplier Control team in Uppsala. This is a highly visible role where you will work closely with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and internal stakeholders across the organization to ensure compliance, quality, and continuous improvement throughout our supply chain.
You will represent Galderma in supplier audits and quality discussions, acting as a trusted quality partner while contributing to the development of our supplier quality processes.
If you enjoy building relationships, driving quality excellence, and taking ownership of complex supplier-related quality activities in a global and regulated environment, this could be the right opportunity for you.
 
Your team
You will join Galderma's Supplier Quality team, a collaborative and highly engaged group within Quality Assurance. The team plays a critical role in ensuring that suppliers, service providers, and contract manufacturers consistently meet Galderma's quality and compliance expectations.
Working closely with colleagues across QA, Procurement, Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T), Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Regulatory Affairs, you will contribute to building a robust supplier network that supports both operational excellence and patient safety.
 
Your mission
As QA Supplier Quality Specialist, your mission is to ensure that Galderma's suppliers and external partners operate in compliance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements. Through proactive supplier oversight, audits, quality agreements, and continuous improvement initiatives, you will help safeguard product quality throughout the supply chain.

About the job
Alfa Laval is investing in digital planning capabilities to create a more connected and consistent supply chain. Today, planning is supported by a mix of solutions, including Blue Yonder, SO99+, Inact Now and Excel. You'll partner with business leaders, planners, architects, analysts and delivery teams to define priorities, guide implementation and improve how Alfa Laval plans demand, supply, production, inventory and service parts. A key challenge will be determining what belongs in the ERP solutions and what is best supported by planning platforms outside the ERP.

Define and communicate the product vision, strategy and roadmap for supply chain planning, aligned with business priorities and long-term objectives. 
Prioritize the product backlog, build business cases and track whether expected benefits are realized. 
Lead the planning product area across demand planning, S&OP/IBP, master planning, supply and production planning, inventory and replenishment, and service parts planning. 
Connect digital capabilities with business processes, including assessing what should be delivered in the ERP and what should be built cross ERPs.

Align stakeholders across Business Units, Operations, Service, IT and senior management. 
Guide delivery in Agile and waterfall environments, working closely with the Product Owner and delivery teams. 
Promote standardization and evaluate new approaches, including AI/ML-based and autonomous planning. 
Support governance, training, adoption and continuous improvement so users can realize the value of new solutions and ways of working. 

 
Who are you
You are an analytical, business-minded partner who can understand how planning works in practice, identify where improvements will matter and turn complex needs into clear priorities. Comfortable with ambiguity and evolving digital products, you take initiative, challenge conventional thinking constructively and bring stakeholders together to make sound decisions and achieve shared goals.

Several years of experience in supply chain planning on the business side, for example as a planner, planning manager or in a comparable role.
A broad understanding of end-to-end supply chain planning, including demand, supply, inventory, production and capacity planning.
Proven experience leading or contributing to a supply chain planning implementation or transformation, with strong project management skills and experience working in both Agile and waterfall environments.

Professional fluency in English.

You'll have the opportunity to shape an evolving digital product area and influence how planning capabilities support Alfa Laval's business, not just how systems are implemented.

Explore how emerging technologies could improve planning and decision-making.
